transcript:
# CITY OF LOWELL AFFORDABLE HOUSING TRUST FUND

## MINUTES

### Mayor's Reception Room, Lowell City Hall

### October 21, 2026 at 4:30 p.m.

**Note:** These minutes are not completed verbatim. For further details, contact the Affordable Housing Trust Fund or refer to video recordings available online at www.LTC.org.

**Date:** October 21, 2026.

**Time:** 4:30 pm

**Location:** Lowell City Hall (375 Merrimack Street)-2nd Floor (Mayors Reception Room)

**I. Members Present:** Conor Baldwin (CFO), Tha Chhan (Ex Officio LHA Director), Valerie Opara (Vice Chairperson), George E. Coulouras (Administrator), Cathy Mercado (MVHP).

**Members Absent:** Eric Nelson (excused)

**Others Present:** Jessica Finocchiaro

*The following represents the actions taken by the Affordable Housing Trust Fund at the 10/21/2026 meeting.*

**II. Meeting Call to Order:**

**Motion** made by Tha Chhan to start the meeting

**Seconded** by: Valerie Opara

**Vote Approved 4-0**

**III. Roll Call Members Present:** Conor Baldwin, Tha Chhan (Ex Officio LHA Director), Cathy Mercado, George E. Coulouras (Administrator), Valerie Opara.

**IV.** Motion made by Conor Baldwin to approve the minutes of October 21, 2026, AHTF Board meeting.

**Seconded by:** Cathy Mercado

**Vote Approved 4-0**

**V. New Business** - Updated balance of the City of Lowell Affordable Housing Trust Fund is including the $310,000.00 of CPC Funding is an estimated $1,206,000.00

**VI. Discussion**

**VII. New Business** - Update of the payment progress of the $500,000.00 Bridge Club/Troubled Waters loan made by AHTF. The administrator George Coulouras has been collecting and servicing the loan while turning the payments in to the Treasurer (copies made available to Board and handed out to all).

**VIII. Discussion**

**IX. New Business** - CPC grant application for $500,000.00 submitted by AHTF Administrator George E. Coulouras

**X. Discussion**

**XI. New Business** - updated Vetted funding opportunities from the City of Lowell

**XII. Discussion** - Conor Baldwin mentioned they have been working on this and hope for a full packet ready for November but it maybe necessary to have a special meeting so we can meet our ARPA funding deadlines. The Board agreed if needed they would meet for special meetings.

**XIII. New Business** - Schedule for next meeting is November 18, 2026 @ 4:30 in the MRR 2cnd Floor of City Hall

**XIV.** Motion made to adjourn meeting - made by Tha Chhan

**Seconded:** Cathy Mercado

**Vote Approved 4-0**

Meeting Adjourned
